entries.title: Show HN: I replaced a $120k bowling center system with $1,600 in ESP32s
entries.author: section33
entries.current_title: Show HN: I replaced a $120k bowling center system with $1,600 in ESP32s
entries.excerpt: I might be the only SRE on Earth with his own bowling center. It's a more in-depth gig than you'd think. My family and I bought an abandoned 8-lane bowling center in the rural mid-west. In our small town there weren't many recreation options for families. You've heard of a food desert? This is an R&R desert. It had been abandoned for a good reason. The roof leaks, the electrical system was constantly surging, and my 70-year-old bowling equipment (still) doesn't work perfectly
entries.guide_zh: 经营八道保龄球馆的工程师，用一千六百美元 ESP32 替代昂贵控制系统。

entries.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
entries.author: gitpusher42
entries.current_title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
entries.excerpt: Hi HN, I built a specialized inference engine for running 4-bit Gemma 4 26B-A4B-IT on any M-series Mac using about 2 GB of RAM. It is called TurboFieldfare and is written in Swift and Metal. I have always adored on-device AI. It feels like magic that you can run a powerful NN on your Mac or iPhone. entries.guide_zh: TurboFieldfare 用 Swift 与 Metal 推理 Gemma 4，作者称 26B 模型只需约 2GB 内存。

entries.title: Show HN: Echo – Fable-level results at 1/3 the cost using open-weight models
entries.author: adam_rida
entries.current_title: Show HN: Echo – Fable-level results at 1/3 the cost using open-weight models
entries.excerpt: I’ve been building Echo ( https://echo.tracerml.ai/ ), an experiment in making one AI system out of a pool of open-weight models rather than choosing a single model and using it for every task. It started with a simple experiment. I took a group of models, including GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.7 and others, and ran them on the same evaluations. Then I measured what would happen if, for each problem, you somehow knew in advance which models would be useful and how their outputs should be
entries.guide_zh: Echo 协调多个开放权重模型，作者称可用三分之一成本达到 Fable 级效果。

entries.title: Show HN: Physically accurate black hole you can put in your room
entries.author: aplavin
entries.current_title: Show HN: Physically accurate black hole you can put in your room
entries.excerpt: We have a black hole at home — with actual relativistic physics, live in your browser. I'm Sasha (Alexander) Plavin, an astrophysicist at Harvard's Black Hole Initiative studying quasars and black hole environments. I work with raytracing/radiative transfer simulations professionally, and wanted to make one anyone can play with — so I built this app. Put the black hole onto your screen (any browser), or directly into your room with AR or VR (requires WebXR, for example Chrome
entries.guide_zh: 天体物理学家把相对论光线追踪带到浏览器，让黑洞模拟进入房间场景。
